title: TPG sells 150-room AC Hotel Miami Beach to Dynamic City Capital for $81M
summary: TPG Real Estate sold the 150-room, 160,460-SF AC Hotel Miami Beach at 2912 Collins Avenue to Utah-based Dynamic City Capital for $81 million, or about $540,000 per room, per records; the deed excludes branding and FF&E value. TPG paid $45.3 million in July 2021. The trade follows Gencom and White Bridge's $300 million InterContinental Miami purchase last month.

title: South Florida October home and condo sales fall as rates and condo financing rules bite
summary: October closings fell year over year: Miami-Dade down 11% to 1,890, Broward down 13% to 1,750 and Palm Beach down about 8% to 1,852. Median single-family prices were $706,000 in Miami-Dade (+3.5%), $610,000 in Broward (-0.2%) and $682,500 in Palm Beach (+6%). Only 21 of nearly 2,400 tri-county condo buildings are FHA-approved.

title: Nearly vacant Lincoln Place leasehold in South Beach under contract for $57.8M
summary: An entity tied to Alfred Equities' Abraham Schwartz and the May family trusts is under contract for $57.8 million to buy the leasehold of Lincoln Place, 1601 Washington Avenue, from Granite Point Mortgage Trust. The 2022 building has 106,700 SF of office, 28,500 SF of retail and a 493-space garage, with nearly 91,000 SF available. Miami Beach holds a right of first refusal; commissioners vote Wednesday.

title: Welltower's South Florida nursing home buying spree reaches $386M across nine properties
summary: Welltower paid $178.2 million last week for four more South Florida nursing and rehab centers, lifting its nine-property total to $386.4 million. The largest was a 294-unit Miami facility at 1442 NW 22nd Street for $74.8 million ($254,500 per unit). All sellers were TL Management entities. The portfolio totals 437,400 SF and 1,223 beds across Broward, Miami-Dade and Palm Beach counties.

title: Great Gulf pauses pre-sales at 87-unit Mandarin Oriental Residences West Palm
summary: Great Gulf has paused pre-sales for its 31-story, 87-unit Mandarin Oriental Residences at 5400 North Flagler Drive in West Palm Beach, missing the prime winter buying season. Sales launched in February but drew limited buyer interest, and a new sales space could take about eight months to build out. TRD counts nearly 15,000 branded and luxury condo units planned, under construction or recently finished in South Florida.

title: Falcone Group lands $85.5M Bank OZK loan for 311-unit Horizon of Oakland Park
summary: Falcone Group secured an $85.5 million senior construction loan from Bank OZK for Horizon of Oakland Park, a $133 million public-private project with 311 apartments and 20,700 square feet of retail on 4 acres. About 20% of units are workforce housing. Construction starts Nov. 16, with completion targeted for early 2029. The deal includes an $8.5 million land purchase from the city.

title: BH Group flips Wellington's Polo West golf course to GL Homes for $62.5M
summary: BH Group is under contract to sell the shuttered 150.5-acre Polo West Golf Course in Wellington to GL Homes for $62.5 million, three times the $20.8 million it paid in May. GL plans 284 luxury homes priced up to $3 million under Florida's Infill Redevelopment Act, which lets qualifying brownfield sites of 5+ acres bypass public hearings and win administrative approvals.

title: RFR lands $101M refi on 317,000-SF 100 Biscayne office tower in downtown Miami
summary: RFR secured a $101 million refinancing for 100 Biscayne Boulevard, a 30-story, 317,000-square-foot office building across from Bayfront Park. Newmark arranged the loan from Derby Lane Partners and Axonic Capital. The tower was listed at $130 million ($419/SF) in February; RFR bought it for $90 million in January 2022. Occupancy rose from under 60% to 90% after renovations, while Class A downtown vacancy was 17% in Q3, per Colliers.

title: PPG gets $97.9M permit for first phase of 728-unit Palm Aire rental project in North Miami Beach
summary: PPG Development, led by Ari Pearl, secured a $97.9M permit for an eight-story and a six-story apartment building plus retail and garage on Lot 1 of its 728-unit Palm Aire project at 1750 NE 167th St. In September PPG and partners closed $235M in construction financing, including a $205M loan from BDT & MSD Partners. PPG bought the site for $31.1M in April 2022.

title: Juwan Howard sells Coral Gables mansion for $25M; Whiteside nets $12.6M in Miami Beach
summary: Juwan Howard sold his 9,000-SF Kobi Karp-designed home at 9440 Old Cutler Lane for $25M, or $2,777 per SF, to attorney Patrick Collins. It was listed at $31.5M and went under contract at $28.9M in September; Howard paid $3.4M in 2013. Hassan Whiteside's 5,400-SF Miami Beach home at 528 Lakeview Court sold for $12.6M, or $2,333 per SF.

title: Ralgo Group pays $53.5M for 267-unit Treetop Apartments in Miami, $200,375/unit
summary: An entity led by Amy and Richard Gonzalez of Ralgo Group bought the 267-unit Treetop Apartments at 8520 SW 107th Ave for $53.5M, or $200,375 per unit. The seller, Residences at 107 Ave. Inc., paid $8.5M in 1995. The 283,700-SF, three-story complex sits on 9.2 acres, was built in 1974 and has two pools; units are listed at $1,750 per month.

title: Blue Spruce Capital family office buys Fisher Island penthouse for $37.5M
summary: Alicia Louise Jarrett's ALJ Properties USA sold a 9,900-SF, seven-bedroom central lower penthouse at 6800 Fisher Island Drive for $37.5M, a steep discount off the original ask. The buyer is an entity managed by Blue Spruce Capital, the family office of energy entrepreneur Michael Smith. Separately, a Glenn Boyer company paid $34.8M for the half-acre lot at 50 West Di Lido Drive, up 26.5% from its 2024 price of $27.5M.

title: Garden Communities affiliate wins Don King's 53-acre Palm Beach fronton with $56.1M bid
summary: K&K Developers, a Garden Communities affiliate, submitted the winning $56.1M all-cash bid at a Nov. 6 bankruptcy auction for the 53-acre Palm Beach Jai Alai site at 1415 45th Street in Mangonia Park, vacant for 32 years. The stalking-horse bid was $55M. Court approval is set for Nov. 12 with a sale Nov. 30; the town has floated up to 2,000 residences.

title: Romanian developer One United injects $43M into Ora by Casa Tua Brickell condo-hotel
summary: One United Properties joined Fortune International's Edgardo Defortuna as JV partner on Ora by Casa Tua, a 77-story, 533-unit condo-hotel planned at 1210 Brickell Avenue, providing $43M in two tranches. The project is about 40% presold at roughly $1,700 to $2,000 per SF. Construction, once slated for 2024, is now expected to start next year.

title: NFL Hall of Famer Fran Tarkenton buys Palm Beach waterfront mansion for $51.9M
summary: Fran Tarkenton paid $51.9M for the 8,720-SF waterfront house at 1620 South Ocean Boulevard, about $5,950 per SF, from Anthony and Lynda Lomangino, who paid $12.7M in 2019 and then remodeled the interior. The 2006-built home has seven bedrooms on 0.67 acres. Christian Angle held the listing; Jana Scarpa of Compass represented Tarkenton.

title: Netscape's Jim Clark buys Palm Beach waterfront compound for $100M off-market
summary: Netscape co-founder Jim Clark and his wife bought the Palm Beach waterfront compound at 1030 North Lake Way from auto mogul David Fischer for $100M off-market, per the Wall Street Journal. That works out to $8,000 per SF across an 8,500-SF main house (built 1998) and a 4,000-SF guest house (built 2025). The Fischers paid $5.3M for the main half-acre in 2000 and $6.8M for the adjacent lot in 2021.
